# sigma_storage_integration (Resource)

Cloud storage integration (S3, GCS or Azure) used for exports and audit logs. An organization that already has one must import it: creating over an existing integration is refused because Sigma would overwrite it. Fields are provider-specific: set the ones that apply to `provider_type`. `bucket_name`, `path_prefix`, `gcp_service_account`, `warehouse_storage_integration_name` and `storage_account` are not returned by Sigma, so changes made outside Terraform to them are not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_storage_integration" "exports" {
  provider_type        = "s3"
  name                 = "exports"
  bucket_name          = "my-sigma-exports"
  path_prefix          = "sigma/"
  storage_aws_role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sigma-exports"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket (S3/GCS) or container (Azure) name.
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix within the bucket or container.
- `provider_type` (String) Storage provider: `s3`, `gcs` or `azure`. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `gcp_service_account` (String) GCS only: service account used to access the bucket.
- `kms_key_name` (String) S3 only: KMS key used for encryption.
- `name` (String) Display name of the integration.
- `storage_account` (String) Azure only: storage account name.
- `storage_aws_role_arn` (String) S3 only: IAM role ARN Sigma assumes.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure only: Azure tenant ID.
- `warehouse_storage_integration_name` (String) GCS only: name of the warehouse storage integration.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_location` (String) Storage location Sigma is allowed to write to, derived from bucket and prefix.
- `external_id` (String) External ID to put in the S3 role trust policy.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# bucket_name and path_prefix are not returned by Sigma: set them in config and the next apply reconciles.
terraform import sigma_storage_integration.example '<storage_integration_id>'
```
